message:
1 classes from the package are invisible to the source scanner:
      PctPhantom (./widget)
description: `./widget` exports a `PctPhantom` the sources do not declare, under two names. It is one class of one entrypoint, and the refusal names it once, with the entrypoint it comes from — the package read named the entrypoint under a field the prepared inputs did not have, and a case printed it as `undefined`.
